description: This is a JUnit test class for testing allergy-related functionalities in the PatientService within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It performs various tests to verify retrieving, setting, and modifying allergy data for patients, including handling reactions, allergen information, and allergy statuses.

classes.name: PatientServiceAllergyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying allergy management functionalities in the PatientService for the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes the PatientService instance and loads test datasets before each test.

methods.name: getAllergyByUuid_shouldGetAllergyByUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving an allergy by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllergies_shouldGetTheAllergyListAndStatus
methods.description: Verifies retrieving the list of allergies for a patient, including allergy reactions and status.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldSaveTheAllergyListAndStatus
methods.description: Tests saving a new list of allergies for a patient and verifies the status update.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidRemovedAllergiesAndMaintainStatusAsSeeListIfSomeAllergiesAreRemoved
methods.description: Checks voiding of allergies when some are removed, maintaining the allergy list status.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllAllergiesAndSetStatusToUnknownIfAllAllergiesAreRemoved
methods.description: Verifies that all allergies are voided and status set to unknown when the entire list is removed.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllAllergiesAndSetStatusToNoKnownAllergiesIfAllAllergiesAreRemovedAndStatusSetAsSuch
methods.description: Checks if all allergies are voided and status set to 'No Known Allergies' when list is cleared with explicit status update.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldSetStatusToNoKnownAllergiesForPatientWithoutAllergies
methods.description: Ensures that a patient without allergies gets the status 'No Known Allergies' after setting an empty list.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedComment
methods.description: Verifies voiding of allergies after editing their comment, triggering save logic.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedSeverity
methods.description: Verifies voiding of allergies after editing severity.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies voiding after editing the coded allergen concept.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies voiding after editing the non-coded allergen string.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithRemovedReactions
methods.description: Checks voiding when reactions are removed from an allergy.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithAddedReactions
methods.description: Checks voiding when reactions are added.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedReactionCoded
methods.description: Verifies voiding when a reaction's coded concept is edited.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Verifies voiding when a reaction's non-coded description is edited.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldSetTheNonCodedConceptForNonCodedAllergenIfNotSpecified
methods.description: Ensures that a non-coded allergen gets its non-coded string set if not provided.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve an allergy from a list by allergy ID.
